steps.title: Read a clock time
steps.body: A schedule often uses the 24-hour clock. In French, write a space, the lower-case symbol h, another space, then the minutes: 9 h 30. Do not write a period after h. In speech, you can say the number of hours directly.

steps.title: Written and spoken times
rows: neuf heures trente / neuf heures et demie
quatorze heures / deux heures de l'après-midi
seize heures quinze / quatre heures quinze de l'après-midi

steps.title: Watch out
steps.body: 12 h means midi (noon); 0 h means minuit (midnight). For a time on a schedule, use h. In a sentence, use à: Le rendez-vous est à 9 h 30.
